desc: Assess test coverage gaps for the app-api zone
context: Look in app/tests/ for tests that cover app/api/**. Identify which API handlers have unit tests, which have integration tests, and which have no tests. The target coverage is 80%. Note any handlers with zero test coverage or with tests that only test happy paths.
acceptance_criteria: Coverage map produced: each API handler mapped to its tests
Handlers with <80% coverage or zero coverage identified
Missing test scenarios noted (edge cases, error paths)
